spec.claim_summary: Buying bitcoin when price falls below the 200-week moving average is presented as a buying opportunity.

claimed.other: Investing $10,000 during the March 2020 dip would have resulted in a 1.8 BTC / $105,000 portfolio today

assumptions: 200-week moving average approximated as 1400-day simple moving average (200*7) on daily bars.
Moving average type not specified; assumed simple moving average as the usual default.
Timeframe 1d chosen from page chart timeframe; claim does not state a timeframe.
No exit stated; assumed long-term buy-and-hold with max_hold_bars 1460 (~4 years) to reflect holding the March 2020 dip to today.

evidence.quote: When Bitcoin's price falls below its 200-week moving average
